findings.passage: The Seven lead rests on something narrower: how he explains what his choices do for him.
findings.problem: No sourced observation separates Type 7 from Type 3, and the article says so ("The call is close"; "the roles and the repairs do not separate the types"). What remains for Seven is self-report from friendly or promotional interviews whose same answers carry audience and commercial framing (NY Post "people took that very bearishly"; Advisor Upside "investors would view it extremely bearishly"; the S42 jacket answer continues into "we obviously have a clothing line" and a "signal" to others; BI "global success"). "First as mood and freedom ... only then as audience" reflects the order of the NY Post article rather than a ranking he gave. The cost reframes ("an undervalued asset", "the third inning") are what an Eightco chairman and a sell-side AI analyst are expected to say. The rival therefore fails no specific, sourced discriminator. A 25-year public record also rules out an open case.
findings.acceptance_test: Research adds at least one dated, sourced observation that one reading predicts and the other does not: his own or named-testimony account of why he left top-ranked FBR research for Synchronoss investor relations in February 2016 and returned via GBH Insights (10/2017) and Wedbush (09/2018); a role taken at a cost to his visibility, or a bigger stage declined because it would box him in; or longer named testimony on what drives him when the work is unseen. The Why-not-Type-3 section and both type FAQs are then restated around that observation (run --refresh --expanded-review if the leading type changes). Until then the profile stays on hold.

findings.passage: He kept the jackets. "I don't take it personally," he said. "It's what I'm comfortable wearing."
findings.problem: The 2022 passage that "leans Seven" quotes only the comfort half of the answer. On my small.en transcript of the downloaded S42 audio (about 00:42:56-00:43:20) he goes on: "You know, we obviously have a clothing line around it as well. And also, I think also it's in a signal to like a lot of people out there where like, when things are tough, you don't like hide..." The commercial and audience-signal parts bear directly on the 7-vs-3 weighing in the next section.
findings.acceptance_test: After a re-listen at about 00:42:50-00:43:20, the passage reports (quoted or paraphrased) that he tied the look to his clothing line and to a signal to others not to hide, and the "closest the record comes to a split" paragraph weighs the whole answer.

findings.problem: Barron's cover story (S08, Jan. 31, 2026) reported that "Ives' Finra records show that he is also now an adviser to a venture-capital fund named Ives Munster AI Revolution Fund." That role does not appear among the six outside activities in the FINRA report retrieved Oct. 24, 2026 (S11). The article never mentions it, so it misses one 2025-26 name-bearing role and one apparent drop. Without it, readers cannot tell what "A number of the roles I no longer have" (plural) covered beyond Eightco.
findings.acceptance_test: Add one attributed, dated clause: Barron's reported the Ives Munster AI Revolution Fund adviser role in January 2026, and FINRA's October 24, 2026 list does not include it. Infer no motive. Alternatively, record in the evidence why it was checked and left out.
